rule: A=sum(exact agreement with both values known)/3, range [0,1]. H=0.5*((crop cosine+1)/2)+0.5*A, range [0,1]. No learned parameters or task-driven rule selection.
missing: Missing/unknown on either side contributes zero, including unknown/unknown. Fixed denominator; no renormalization. If all agreements are zero, attribute-only uses ID order and hybrid preserves crop ordering. Missing/nonfinite embedding scores fail closed before scoring; no substitute model.
ties: Descending score, then ascending compound wardrobe_id/item_id. No relevance, source paths, filenames, raw VLM prose or notes in scorer inputs.
ablation: Remove each field contribution in turn, keeping denominator 3, embedding weight 0.5 and each remaining field weight 1/6 fixed. Diagnostic only; do not select a new rule.
abstention: Primary rankings return the full identical pool. Secondary: original full/crop cosine >=0.60 only on original [-1,1] scale. Hybrid uses exactly the crop accept mask, then returns its reranked full pool. This tests ordering only. No attribute or hybrid threshold and no new abstention rule.
assistance: Owner-confirmed wardrobe attributes and query attributes labeled on owner-selected crops. Assisted development experiment; SmolVLM had 0/28 valid structured predictions and supplies no ranking features.
limits: 13 correlated tasks, one wardrobe/reviewer, no fitted weights, no held-out claim. Human annotation effort unknown. Preserve existing files. No downloads/inference. Final-test data sealed or uncollected; final contract open; stage advancement belongs to master roadmap.
